78: 	private JCMethodDecl createRecordArgslessConstructor(JavacNode typeNode, JavacNode source, JCMethodDecl existingCtr) {
79: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
80: 		
81: 		java.util.List<JCVariableDecl> fields = new ArrayList<JCVariableDecl>();
82: 		for (JavacNode child : typeNode.down()) {
83: 			if (child.getKind() == Kind.FIELD) {
84: 				JCVariableDecl v = (JCVariableDecl) child.get();
85: 				if ((v.mods.flags & RECORD) != 0) {
86: 					fields.add(v);
87: 				}
88: 			}
89: 		}
90: 		
91: 		ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl> params = new ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl>();
92: 		
93: 		for (int i = 0; i < fields.size(); i++) {
94: 			JCVariableDecl arg = fields.get(i);
95: 			JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(GENERATED_MEMBER | Flags.PARAMETER, arg.mods.annotations);
96: 			params.append(maker.VarDef(mods, arg.name, arg.vartype, null));
97: 		}
98: 		
99: 		JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(toJavacModifier(AccessLevel.PUBLIC) | COMPACT_RECORD_CONSTRUCTOR, List.<JCAnnotation>nil());
100: 		JCBlock body = maker.Block(0L, List.<JCStatement>nil());
101: 		if (existingCtr == null) {
102: 			JCMethodDecl constr = maker.MethodDef(mods, typeNode.toName("<init>"), null, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil(), params.toList(), List.<JCExpression>nil(), body, null);
103: 			return recursiveSetGeneratedBy(constr, source);
104: 		} else {

106: 			existingCtr.body = body;
107: 			existingCtr = recursiveSetGeneratedBy(existingCtr, source);
108: 			addSuppressWarningsAll(existingCtr.mods, typeNode, typeNode.getNodeFor(getGeneratedBy(existingCtr)), typeNode.getContext());
109: 			addGenerated(existingCtr.mods, typeNode, typeNode.getNodeFor(getGeneratedBy(existingCtr)), typeNode.getContext());
110: 			return existingCtr;
111: 		}

115: 	 * If the provided typeNode is a record, returns the compact constructor (there should only be one, but if the file is

117: 	 * a new explicit one is created, and that one is returned in a list.
118: 	 * 
119: 	 * Otherwise, an empty list is returned.

125: 		if (typeNode == null || !(typeNode.get() instanceof JCClassDecl)) return answer;

127: 		JCClassDecl cDecl = (JCClassDecl) typeNode.get();
128: 		if (!isRecord(typeNode)) return answer;

130: 		boolean generateConstructor = false;
131: 		
132: 		JCMethodDecl existingCtr = null;
133: 		
134: 		for (JCTree def : cDecl.defs) {
135: 			if (def instanceof JCMethodDecl) {
136: 				JCMethodDecl md = (JCMethodDecl) def;
137: 				if (md.name.contentEquals("<init>")) {
138: 					if ((md.mods.flags & Flags.GENERATEDCONSTR) != 0) {
139: 						existingCtr = md;
140: 						existingCtr.mods.flags = existingCtr.mods.flags & ~Flags.GENERATEDCONSTR;
141: 						generateConstructor = true;
142: 					} else {
143: 						if (!isTolerate(typeNode, md)) {
144: 							if ((md.mods.flags & COMPACT_RECORD_CONSTRUCTOR) != 0) {
145: 								generateConstructor = false;
146: 								answer = answer.prepend(md);

148: 						}
149: 					}
150: 				}
151: 			}
152: 		}
153: 		
154: 		if (generateConstructor) {

212: 	private void addNullCheckIfNeeded(JCMethodDecl method, JavacNode paramNode, JavacNode source) {
213: 		// Possibly, if 'declaration instanceof ConstructorDeclaration', fetch declaration.constructorCall, search it for any references to our parameter,
214: 		// and if they exist, create a new method in the class: 'private static <T> T lombok$nullCheck(T expr, String msg) {if (expr == null) throw NPE; return expr;}' and
215: 		// wrap all references to it in the super/this to a call to this method.
216: 		
217: 		JCStatement nullCheck = recursiveSetGeneratedBy(generateNullCheck(source.getTreeMaker(), paramNode, source), source);
218: 		
219: 		if (nullCheck == null) {
220: 			// @NonNull applied to a primitive. Kinda pointless. Let's generate a warning.
221: 			source.addWarning("@NonNull is meaningless on a primitive.");
222: 			return;
223: 		}
224: 		
225: 		List<JCStatement> statements = method.body.stats;
226: 		
227: 		String expectedName = paramNode.getName();
228: 		
229: 		/* Abort if the null check is already there, delving into try and synchronized statements */ {
230: 			List<JCStatement> stats = statements;
231: 			int idx = 0;
232: 			while (stats.size() > idx) {
233: 				JCStatement stat = stats.get(idx++);
234: 				if (JavacHandlerUtil.isConstructorCall(stat)) continue;
235: 				if (stat instanceof JCTry) {
236: 					stats = ((JCTry) stat).body.stats;
237: 					idx = 0;
238: 					continue;
239: 				}
240: 				if (stat instanceof JCSynchronized) {
241: 					stats = ((JCSynchronized) stat).body.stats;
242: 					idx = 0;
243: 					continue;
244: 				}
245: 				String varNameOfNullCheck = returnVarNameIfNullCheck(stat);
246: 				if (varNameOfNullCheck == null) break;
247: 				if (varNameOfNullCheck.equals(expectedName)) return;
248: 			}
249: 		}
250: 		
251: 		List<JCStatement> tail = statements;
252: 		List<JCStatement> head = List.nil();
253: 		for (JCStatement stat : statements) {
254: 			if (JavacHandlerUtil.isConstructorCall(stat) || (JavacHandlerUtil.isGenerated(stat) && isNullCheck(stat))) {
255: 				tail = tail.tail;
256: 				head = head.prepend(stat);
257: 				continue;
258: 			}
259: 			break;
260: 		}
261: 		
262: 		List<JCStatement> newList = tail.prepend(nullCheck);
263: 		for (JCStatement stat : head) newList = newList.prepend(stat);
264: 		method.body.stats = newList;
265: 		source.getAst().setChanged();
266: 	}

268: 	@Override public void handle(AnnotationValues<NonNull> annotation, JCAnnotation ast, JavacNode annotationNode) {
269: 		handleFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.NON_NULL_FLAG_USAGE, "@NonNull");
270: 		if (annotationNode.up().getKind() == Kind.FIELD) {
271: 			// This is meaningless unless the field is used to generate a method (@Setter, @RequiredArgsConstructor, etc),
272: 			// but in that case those handlers will take care of it. However, we DO check if the annotation is applied to
273: 			// a primitive, because those handlers trigger on any annotation named @NonNull and we only want the warning
274: 			// behaviour on _OUR_ 'lombok.NonNull'.
275: 			
276: 			try {
277: 				if (isPrimitive(((JCVariableDecl) annotationNode.up().get()).vartype)) {
278: 					annotationNode.addWarning("@NonNull is meaningless on a primitive.");
279: 				}
280: 			} catch (Exception ignore) {}
281: 			
282: 			JCVariableDecl fDecl = (JCVariableDecl) annotationNode.up().get();
283: 			if ((fDecl.mods.flags & RECORD) != 0) {
284: 				// well, these kinda double as parameters (of the compact constructor), so we do some work here.
285: 				
286: 				List<JCMethodDecl> compactConstructors = addCompactConstructorIfNeeded(annotationNode.up().up(), annotationNode);
287: 				for (JCMethodDecl ctr : compactConstructors) {
288: 					addNullCheckIfNeeded(ctr, annotationNode.up(), annotationNode);
289: 				}
290: 			}
291: 			return;
292: 		}
293: 		
294: 		JCMethodDecl declaration;
295: 		JavacNode paramNode;
296: 		
297: 		switch (annotationNode.up().getKind()) {
298: 		case ARGUMENT:
299: 			paramNode = annotationNode.up();
300: 			break;
301: 		case TYPE_USE:
302: 			JavacNode typeNode = annotationNode.directUp();
303: 			paramNode = typeNode.directUp();
304: 			break;
305: 		default:
306: 			return;
307: 		}
308: 		
309: 		if (paramNode.getKind() != Kind.ARGUMENT) return;
310: 		try {
311: 			declaration = (JCMethodDecl) paramNode.up().get();
312: 		} catch (Exception e) {
313: 			return;
314: 		}
315: 		
316: 		if (declaration.body == null) {
317: 			// This used to be a warning, but as @NonNull also has a documentary purpose, better to not warn about this. Since 1.16.7
318: 			return;
319: 		}
320: 		
321: 		if ((declaration.mods.flags & (GENERATED_MEMBER | COMPACT_RECORD_CONSTRUCTOR)) != 0) {
322: 			// The 'real' annotations are on the `record Foo(@NonNull Obj x)` part and we just see these
323: 			// syntax-sugared over. We deal with it on the field declaration variant, as those are always there,
324: 			// not dependent on whether you write out the compact constructor or not.
325: 			return;
326: 		}
327: 		
328: 		addNullCheckIfNeeded(declaration, paramNode, annotationNode);
329: 	}

331: 	public boolean isNullCheck(JCStatement stat) {
332: 		return returnVarNameIfNullCheck(stat) != null;
333: 	}
334: 	
335: 	/**
336: 	 * Checks if the statement is of the form 'if (x == null) {throw WHATEVER;}' or 'assert x != null;',
337: 	 * where the block braces are optional. If it is of this form, returns "x".
338: 	 * If it is not of this form, returns null.
339: 	 */
340: 	public String returnVarNameIfNullCheck(JCStatement stat) {
341: 		boolean isIf = stat instanceof JCIf;
342: 		boolean isExpression = stat instanceof JCExpressionStatement;
343: 		if (!isIf && !(stat instanceof JCAssert) && !isExpression) return null;
344: 		
345: 		if (isExpression) {
346: 			/* Check if the statements contains a call to checkNotNull or requireNonNull */
347: 			JCExpression expression = ((JCExpressionStatement) stat).expr;
348: 			if (expression instanceof JCAssign) expression = ((JCAssign) expression).rhs;
349: 			if (!(expression instanceof JCMethodInvocation)) return null;
350: 			
351: 			JCMethodInvocation invocation = (JCMethodInvocation) expression;
352: 			JCExpression method = invocation.meth;
353: 			Name name = null;
354: 			if (method instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
355: 				name = ((JCFieldAccess) method).name;
356: 			} else if (method instanceof JCIdent) {
357: 				name = ((JCIdent) method).name;
358: 			}
359: 			if (name == null || (!name.contentEquals("checkNotNull") && !name.contentEquals("requireNonNull"))) return null;
360: 			
361: 			if (invocation.args.isEmpty()) return null;
362: 			JCExpression firstArgument = invocation.args.head;
363: 			if (!(firstArgument instanceof JCIdent)) return null;
364: 			return ((JCIdent) firstArgument).toString();
365: 		}
366: 		
367: 		if (isIf) {
368: 			/* Check that the if's statement is a throw statement, possibly in a block. */
369: 			JCStatement then = ((JCIf) stat).thenpart;
370: 			if (then instanceof JCBlock) {
371: 				List<JCStatement> stats = ((JCBlock) then).stats;
372: 				if (stats.length() == 0) return null;
373: 				then = stats.get(0);
374: 			}
375: 			if (!(then instanceof JCThrow)) return null;
376: 		}
377: 		
378: 		/* Check that the if's conditional is like 'x == null'. Return from this method (don't generate
379: 		   a nullcheck) if 'x' is equal to our own variable's name: There's already a nullcheck here. */ {
380: 			JCExpression cond = isIf ? ((JCIf) stat).cond : ((JCAssert) stat).cond;
381: 			while (cond instanceof JCParens) cond = ((JCParens) cond).expr;
382: 			if (!(cond instanceof JCBinary)) return null;
383: 			JCBinary bin = (JCBinary) cond;
384: 			if (isIf) {
385: 				if (!CTC_EQUAL.equals(treeTag(bin))) return null;
386: 			} else {
387: 				if (!CTC_NOT_EQUAL.equals(treeTag(bin))) return null;
388: 			}
389: 			if (!(bin.lhs instanceof JCIdent)) return null;
390: 			if (!(bin.rhs instanceof JCLiteral)) return null;
391: 			if (!CTC_BOT.equals(typeTag(bin.rhs))) return null;
392: 			return ((JCIdent) bin.lhs).name.toString();
393: 		}
394: 	}
